aboutIntro: An independent public-interest project documenting maritime-security incidents relevant to the EU Black Sea coast of Romania and Bulgaria: attacks on vessels, drifting sea mines, drone debris, attacks affecting ports, and the official response.
aboutEditorText: An independent research project. It is not an EU institution and has no affiliation with NATO or any government.
aboutScopeText: Reported attacks on vessels, naval mines found or neutralised, drone fragments on Romanian or Bulgarian territory, and attacks affecting ports or coastal facilities. Mine-countermeasure operations are listed as responses, not attacks, and are excluded from incident counts.
aboutEvidenceText: Every record links to its sources. Official means a first-party institutional release; Press means media reporting; Auto-indexed means a discovered lead awaiting review. Attribution is shown as claimed by a party, confirmed by authorities, or undetermined. A claim is not a confirmed finding, and several outlets repeating one claim do not make it independent.
aboutLocationText: Map positions are approximate areas, often offshore anchors or the nearest port. They are never verified strike coordinates and must not be used for navigation. Records without a reliable location appear only in the list.
aboutUpdatesText: Feeds are checked about every six hours; new leads are reviewed before publication. The data is neither complete nor real-time. To request a correction, send the record link, a primary source and a short explanation.
